t: Variants to the first act of D. Lalli
Variants to act second by D. Lalli
Variants to the third act of D. Lalli
d: Piazza di Messene with throne. Grand'ara in the middle with the statue of Hercules crowned with poplar. Temple closed in the distance. The whole scene is adorned with crowns, and poplar branches, consecrated to Hercules. Epitis.

And they carry in their hands branches, and crowns of poplar, and girding in ordinance the throne, and the statue, prostrate themselves in the act of offering their branches, and their crowns. Epitis aside.
Polyphon, and Trasimede coming out of the temple with Séguito. Epitide on the side. Polyphon sits on the throne.
Polifonte's rooms in a villa with a secret door.
From the libretto musicato in 1734 by G. Giacomelli.
Montuosa with rock in the upper, cave in the middle, and delicious palace in the lower. Polifonte, Licisco.
Preceded by festive follow-up of Messeni, Epitide comes out of the cave and comes down from the mountain. The above.
Anaxandro in chains between Guards, and sayings.
Room with throne, and seats. Argia, Licisk, and then Epitis.
Merope, Trasimede, Licisco and Epitide. Following of Peoples and Soldiers. Then Polyphon.
Anaxander chained between Guards, and sayings.
Polyphony, Trasimede, Epitide, Licisk, and Anassandro.
From the libretto musicato in 1734 by G. Giacomelli.
Part of the royal garden with a large isolated tree. Polyphon, and Argia.
Polyphon, then Anassandro among the Archers.
Anassandro tied up to be saed by the Archers, and Licisco.
Royal salon closed in the middle by curtains hanging from the ceiling of it. Polifonte, Licisco, and then Trasimede.
Merope between Guards, and said so.
Epitide, Argia, Anassandro, and so forth. Following of Messeni, and Soldiers.
From the libretto musicato in 1734 by G. Giacomelli.
